subject: Random intercept cross-lagged panel model using lavaan

messages.author: c41d845707fcb1ae
messages.subject: Random intercept cross-lagged panel model using lavaan
parts:
Hi everyone,
I have a question regarding how to construct a RI-CLPM using Lavaan. The current project I' am working on involves 2 variables measured across 2 waves of data. I am attempting to  examine if any bidirectional relationship exist between x and y (figure shown as below) using both CLPM and RI-CLPM, following up with comparison of the fit of these two models.

However, the RI-CLPM cannot run successfully using the following code.
riclpmModel <-
'#Latent mean Structure with intercepts
kappa =~ 1*x1 + 1*x2 
omega =~ 1*y1 + 1*y2 

x1 ~ mu1*1 #intercepts
x2 ~ mu2*1
y1 ~ pi1*1
y2 ~ pi2*1

kappa ~~ kappa 
omega ~~ omega 
kappa ~~ omega 

#laten vars for AR and cross-lagged effects
p1 =~ 1*x1 #each factor loading set to 1
p2 =~ 1*x2

q1 =~ 1*y1
q2 =~ 1*y2

p2 ~ alpha2*p1 + beta2*q1
q2 ~ delta2*q1 + gamma2*p1

p1 ~~ p1 #variance
p2 ~~ u2*p2
q1 ~~ q1 #variance
q2 ~~ v2*q2

p1 ~~ q1 #p1 and q1 covariance
p2 ~~ q2 #p2 and q2 covariance'

fit <- lavaan(riclpmModel, data = data,
              missing = 'ML', #for the missing data!
              int.ov.free = F,
              int.lv.free = F,
              auto.fix.first = F,
              auto.fix.single = F,
              auto.cov.lv.x = F,
              auto.cov.y = F,
              auto.var = F)         
summary(fit, fit.measures = T) 

 Warning messages were:
1: In lav_model_estimate(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavpartable = lavpartable,  :
  lavaan WARNING: the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found!
2: In lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats,  :
  lavaan WARNING:
    Could not compute standard errors! The information matrix could
    not be inverted. This may be a symptom that the model is not
    identified.
3: In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: some estimated lv variances are negative
> summary(fit, fit.measures = T)

I referred to Hamaker's blog (https://jflournoy.github.io/2017/10/20/riclpm-lavaan-demo/) for the code since I've no experience in SEM and CLPM. 

Anyone have any advice on this? Any help would be really appreciated!

Sophie

Others may be able to provide a more detailed response but I don’t think you can use RI with only two waves of data. Cheers, Borja
